doc.name: VTM-G with gripper (DFW6 order buffer VTM)

$comment: The VTM that works DFW6's order buffer aisles, 8 in the map as 'VTM (gripper)'. Figures are the bot specifications Vinay directed on 2026-09-21, from GreyOrange's hardware team (docs/walmart-facts.md section 6b): provisional, 'to be used for this week' while HAI vetting is in progress. No confirmed maker or model: the map calls it VTM-G, Vinay asks 'gripper vtm?', and the draft catalog on equipment/world-protocol-0.8 names HAI Robotics while marking that unconfirmed. The matrix has no Walmart gripper column; its generic gripper column, C56-G-2D, times a pick or a drop at 5.0 s. The directive's VTM rows cover both VTM families, so these figures match the suction VTM's except for the end effector.

floor_drive.$comment: The directive states no turn times, and the simulator needs none: it keeps DFW6's VTMs in their aisles.

lift.$comment: The directive gives one VTM speed and acceleration; the simulator applies them to the lift as well, which is still to be confirmed.
